capabilities: Define key-value variable replacements in settings
Expand variables in notes using HTML comment markers
Compute dynamic values with function expressions like now() and format()
Control when expansions update via auto, manual, once, and once-and-eject modes
Filter which folders are scanned and run replacement commands per note or vault
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later (declarative settings API); full documentation lives in a separate docs/ folder. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's Templates only fill content when a note is created; there is no built-in way to keep recurring variables substituted and up to date inside existing notes.
summary: Variable expansion plugin that replaces key-value variables inside HTML comment markers across vault notes, with static and dynamic values.
